Track down [[Sandre Elek|Sandre]]'s [[Orion|brother]], a man of [[royalist]] leanings, and convince him to return home by appealing to his vanity.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
| minimum = 2
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to [[Ralena Stormbringer]] in [[Foible's Fair]] to learn [[Orion]]'s whereabouts.
* Find Orion in [[Wizard's Folly]] and convince him to come home.
* Return to Sandre Elek for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Air Staff (lightning spire)|Air Staff (lightning spire)]]
** [[Energy]] +3
** [[Lightning Dmg]]: 3-5
** [[Armor penetration]] +10% (Chance: 5%)
** Armor +7  (vs. [[Piercing damage]])
** Two-handed

==Walkthrough==
Travel to Foible's Fair and talk to Ralena Stormbringer for a lead on Orion. To find him, exit the outpost, following the road northeast until you reach a house on your left. From there, head west through the trees toward the quest marker.

There is a large number of level 3 [[Black Bear]]s and [[Bandit Blood Sworn]] along the way; draw them out carefully to avoid being overwhelmed. Once you break the news to Orion about his romantic rival, travel back to Ascalon City and speak to Sandre Elek for the reward.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
* {{e}} 2 [[Orion|Orion Elek]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Sandre Elek
:''"I'm sorry to bother you, but I've heard some impressive things about you, and I think only someone with your skill and bravery can help me with my problem.''

:''"I think my brother '''Orion''' has fallen in with the Royalists. He's not wicked, just reckless and impulsive. When [[Sir Tydus]] expelled him from the Academy, he became embittered toward the army, but I don't think he realizes how serious this is. I don't want him to throw his life away for foolish pride. Do you think you could find him and tell him what I said? Perhaps convince him to come home?''

:''"I don't know exactly where he is, but I imagine '''Ralena Stormbringer''' in '''Foible's Fair''' might. Orion was always trying to impress her. He might have told her something."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll try to bring your brother home.
| decline = Orion must live with his decisions.
| ask = Please. Have you found my brother yet? I have no more information to give you but that I think he's hiding out in '''[[Green Hills County]]'''. {{sic|Should likely be Wizard's Folly.}}
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Ralena Stormbringer
:''"Aye, I can tell you where Orion went. He headed out northwest past the road. He thinks he'll find some Royalists there, but Vassar thinks it won't work. I hope he doesn't get himself killed, but he can't expect me to go tromping all over the mountain looking for him."''

'''If you have not talked to Ralena Stormbringer'''
;Orion Elek
:''Hmph. Sandre's a sweet girl, but she's very naive about the ways of the world. Some day, you will all see that peace and order can only be restored fully to Ascalon when the rightful royal line is restored to the throne.
'''If you have talked to Ralena Stormbringer'''
;Orion Elek
:''"What's this? Vassar is at the Fair, cozying up to Ralena!? Curse the day I was born! What am I doing out here? The revolution will have to wait!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Sandre Elek
:''"Praise Dwayna! I'm so relieved to know he's left the Royalists. I feared he was lost to us forever."''

==Notes==
*Talking to Orion before talking to Ralena Stormbringer will initiate a dialogue with him, but he will not be swayed.
*Orion starts walking as soon as you get done talking to him and, unless killed along the way, ultimately returns to Foible's Fair.
